title: rhododendron lapponicum var. parvifolium
intro: Rhododendron lapponicum var. parvifolium, commonly known as Dwarf Labrador Tea or Parvifolium Rhododendron, is a plant species belonging to the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits in treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron lapponicum var. parvifolium include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help in relieving congestion and promoting the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are known for their antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
